messages:
Mike: T-minus 25m — starting quiet window prep. quick sweep please, call out blockers now.
Lauren: I have the pin list ready and attached to the runbook. no outstanding PR approvals.
Odessa: My team finished the smoke for embeddings routes, latencies look stable.
Carla: Two minor infra jobs pending in staging that could touch model cache; I can hold them.
Mike: Hold them. we don't want cache churn during canary.
Deploy-bot: :robot_face: Canary rollout scheduled in 20m. plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 5m observation per stage. health checks: 200, p99 < 350ms.
SRE-Oncall: I'll watch infra metrics and alerts. threshold: error rate > 0.5% for 3m triggers rollback.
Sam: Product sig-off in 15m unless we see regression in quality metrics (p0 prompts).
Lauren: Final pin list summary:
- model: rwd/lite-v2@v2026-03-10
- routing: primary us-west, fallback us-east
- quant profile: q4_0 (recommended)
- cache TTL: 10m
Carla: Noted. I've set owner tags on the pin for visibility.
Mike: Rollback owners: Lauren (api), Carla (infra), Odessa (model quality). if rollback happens, escalate to Sam for customer comms.
Odessa: Quick note: if we see KV cache spikes, fallback to non-cached model variant (rwd/lite-v2@cpu-compat) — lower perf but safe.
Deploy-bot: :warning: Preflight check: 3/4 canary instances ready, 1 failing due to missing cert. action: Carla to re-run cert job.
Carla: Re-running cert job now. ETA ~2m.
Mike: Great. once Deploy-bot reports all instances ready we proceed. annotate any deviations in the runbook `quiet-window` section.
Deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: All canary instances healthy. proceeding to 10% traffic.
Lauren: Monitoring logs and traces, looking for new 5xx patterns.
SRE-Oncall: Metrics green for 10% for 6m. moving to 50% is OK from infra side.
Deploy-bot: Canary at 50% now. observation window started.
Odessa: Running quick eval set (n=50) — no quality regressions so far.
Sam: Not seeing any product regressions in the spot checks. green from my side.
Mike: Keep eyes on cost metrics — embeddings burst could surprise billing. notify if tokens/sec > expected by 20%.
Carla: I'll watch GPU utilization and autoscaler logs.
Deploy-bot: :rocket: Canary completed to 100% after steady windows. Final status: success.
Lauren: Publishing release notes: short blurb + changelog + rollback instructions. I've linked runbook.
Mike: Thanks everyone. post-mortem owners assigned if anything pops in next 24h: Lauren + SRE-Oncall.
Sam: I'll draft customer comms if required.
Odessa: Leaving a quick tip in runbook: how to force-unpin if we need to revert models quickly. use `infra pin remove --model rwd/lite-v2@v2026-03-10`
Carla: Unpin command acknowledged.
Mike: Quiet window over — still monitor for 1h. :thumbsup:
